sources.title: TNGIS open GeoServer (WFS): district, taluk, block and village panchayat boundaries, TN WRD sub-basins and reservoirs, micro-watershed atlas, all-water-bodies and all-tanks registers, mine leases, industry register matched to land parcels
sources.license: Tamil Nadu government data on an open GeoServer (WFS, no login); published with TNGIS's permission and with attribution.

provenance.note: Ranipet district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope ranipet-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-ranipet). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.
